title: Field weeknote — Sprint 17 check-ins (VPC / on-prem)
content:
Purpose:
Quick field-facing summary for Sprint 17 (week of 2025-06-09) — consolidation of standups, install notes, and customer blockers for the Private Deployments squad. Meant for SRE handoff, solutions-eng sync, and EM visibility.

Attendees (recurring):
- Lena Chen (owner, install lead)
- Marco Ruiz (networking, field eng)
- Aisha Patel (solutions eng, security lead)
- Dmitri Volkov (telemetry / install ops)
- Sofia Martinez (customer success observer)
- occasional: product-oncall, infra-ops rep

Summary / high-level wins:
- Completed Atlas customer preflight validation (network rules + KMS test) on 06-11; initial tokenization test passed on dev overlay cluster.
- New offline-install checklist v2 merged to Confluence (PD-Install-Checklist-2025) which trims the manual RSA key steps — reduces handoff time ~15m.
- Pilot rolling snapshot for Beacon (on-prem) succeeded for 2-node failover test; KV cache warm restore observed within SLA.

Ongoing customer-specific notes (ranked by priority):
1) Meridian (large-fintech, VPC private): blocker — intermittent egress NAT flapping seen during large model downloads (model artifacts ~20GB). Observed around 06-10 07:12-07:45 UTC.
   - Symptoms: s3 pulls time out, install stage "fetch-model" retries then aborts.
   - Temporary mitigation: shift downloads to region-mirror and enable small 10s backoff; scheduled full-model rsync after business hours.
   - Next steps: Marco to open network packet capture with Meridian net team (JIRA-PD-3124). Action owner: Marco, due 2025-06-14.

2) Beacon (edge on-prem retail): blocker — telemetry agent crashes on low-memory POS devices after repeated small inference bursts.
   - Root cause hypothesis: agent OOM due to memory leak in local metrics buffer when process pinned to tiny cgroup (128MB).
   - Short-term: downgrading sampling to 1/10 and enabling process-level swap file (customer-approved).
   - Long-term: Dmitri to produce a memory profile and propose a lean agent build (JIRA-PD-3199). ETA: 2025-06-20.

3) Atlas (healthcare, VPC w/ HSM): mostly green but compliance ask outstanding — customer needs per-token audit hooks surfaced into their SIEM for PII redaction events.
   - Aisha to draft the minimal webhook format and a rollout cadence. Slack thread: #atlas-hsm-compliance. Target spec by 2025-06-17.

Standup highlights & loose decisions:
- Canaries: we will run a 2-hour canary window before any model artifact refresh for customers with constrained networks. Approved by EM on 06-12.
- Install runbook adjustments: add a "network throttling assessment" step before model fetch for customers with public-cloud egress limits. Lena to update runbook (confluence link above) by 06-15.
- Rollback guard: add an explicit TTL and health-check gate for any auto-rollback triggers to avoid mid-install flapping across control-plane and compute-plane.

Open action items (owner / ticket / due):
- PD-3124: Meridian NAT flapping investigation — Marco — due 2025-06-14.
- PD-3199: Beacon telemetry memory profile + lean-agent PR — Dmitri — due 2025-06-20.
- Doc task: add network-throttle step to PD runbook — Lena — due 2025-06-15.
- Compliance spec: Atlas SIEM webhook draft — Aisha — due 2025-06-17.
- Customer comms: send Meridian install delay notice (business-hours rsync) — Sofia + solutions-eng — due 2025-06-13 (sent).

Risks & notes to leadership:
- Model artifact transfer strategy remains the single largest delivery risk for VPC installs; large customers on constrained links may need pre-seeded disks or physical media. We should consider a "pre-seed" logistics playbook and a small budget line to ship encrypted NVMe disks for >100TB-class transfers.
- If Beacon agent memory leak persists, will impact >10 retail sites with lower-spec hardware; could push SLA exceptions. Recommend gating any fleet-wide agent upgrade until a patched lean build is validated.

Meeting minutes (6/11 field sync):
- Marco walked through packet captures (attached to JIRA) showing uneven NAT port reuse; action: Meridian to confirm NAT gateway config and keepalive timers.
- Dmitri demoed the new metrics endpoint sampling toggle and proposed a 1-line change to the systemd unit to constrain RSS.
- Aisha confirmed HSM test vectors passed but requested an additional audit hook for redaction events — action item created.

Loose ideas / brainstorm (notes to self):
- Could we add a "model seed registry" in Console so a customer can request a pre-seeded model image and we can track shipping/validation? Minimal UX + CLI for ops.
- Shipping offline images: explore partnership with a logistics vendor (ShipFast) and template for encrypted disk handling (KMS wrap + chain of custody checklist).

Blocker escalation ladder (reminder):
- Level 1 (field): owner + solutions-eng on call.
- Level 2 (squad EM + infra-ops) within 2 business hours for customer-impacting installs.
- Level 3 (VP eng + legal/compliance if regulated) within 6 business hours for PII or HSM incidents.

Next checkpoints / calendar:
- Daily standup (15m) 09:30 PDT 06/10 — recurring.
- Sprint 17 wrap & demo: 2025-06-19 16:00 PDT.
- Meridian post-mitigation follow-up call: 2025-06-15 08:00 UTC (scheduled).

Appendix: quick links & artifacts referenced:
- PD runbook (v2): https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/PD-Install-Checklist-2025
- Meridian net trace (attached to JIRA-PD-3124)
- Beacon telemetry crash logs: s3://pd-ops-artifacts/beacon/2025-06-11/crash-logs.tgz

Notes to self: keep these weeknotes concise, push urgent customer items into Slack thread and JIRA tickets so they are visible to oncall. This doc is snapshot — update when action items close.

---
